title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Gerente de projetos SAP sênior
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Sênior para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de migração SAP ECC → S/4HANA, assumindo papel-chave na transformação digital da organização. Este(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir projetos de alta complexidade, garantindo a integração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, o alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e a entrega de resultados com qualidade, prazo e custo controlados.

É essencial que o candidato possua conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, permitindo compreender impactos funcionais e tecnológicos, dialogar com equipes de migração de dados, Basis, funcionais (FI/MM/SD/BP) e arquitetos de soluções, além de garantir aderência às melhores práticas e metodologias de migração.


Atividades

  • Planejar, coordenar e liderar projetos de migração de alta complexidade no ecossistema SAP.
  • Atuar de forma próxima às equipes técnicas e funcionais, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em planos de execução viáveis.
  • Elaborar, controlar e atualizar cronograma, escopo, orçamento e plano de comunicação do projeto.
  • Planejar e supervisionar as estratégias de migração de dados, desde inventário, mapeamento, saneamento até cargas e validações finais.
  • Coordenar ciclos de conversão, testes integrados (SIT/UAT), cutover e estabilização pós-go live.
  • Identificar, monitorar e mitigar riscos e impactos de mudanças de escopo, assegurando compliance com premissas e restrições.
  • Gerenciar stakeholders internos e externos, promovendo alinhamento e comunicação executiva clara.
  • Garantir que o projeto seja executado dentro dos prazos, custos e qualidade definidos, reportando status para comitês e diretoria.
  • Produzir e consolidar documentações de acompanhamento, lições aprendidas e relatórios executivos.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Superior completo em TI, Engenharias, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de projetos complexos, com ênfase em migração SAP ECC → SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimento técnico do ecossistema SAP, incluindo módulos principais (FI, MM, SD, BP) e integração com áreas funcionais.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas e metodologias de migração SAP (SAP Migration Cockpit, LSMW, SAP Data Services, BW/4HANA Transfer Cockpit).
  • Domínio da metodologia SAP Activate, incluindo suas fases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das estratégias de conversão: Brownfield, Greenfield e Bluefield.
  • Experiência em SAP ECC, incluindo entendimento de dados mestres, transacionais e processos críticos de negócio.
  • Certificação em gerenciamento de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP ou equivalentes).


Diferenciais

  • Certificações SAP Activate e/ou SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência prévia em programas de transformação digital envolvendo Data & Analytics, Cloud e Integração com Databricks/Azure/AWS.
  • Vivência em ambientes multinacionais, com comunicação em inglês avançado para reuniões e documentação.
  • Conhecimento em gestão financeira de projetos (FTEs, burn rate, CAPEX/OPEX).

title: Assessor comercial
description:
Assessor(a) de Atendimento Comercial B2C | Afetto Design


Presencial | São Paulo | CLT


A Afetto Design é uma startup do setor moveleiro em crescimento exponencial, criada para ir além do óbvio. Somos uma marca autoral de mobiliário infantil de alto padrão, reconhecida por desenvolver peças que atravessam fases, unem estética, funcionalidade e segurança, e entregam cuidado em cada detalhe — do design à experiência final do cliente.


Desde o início, nossa ambição sempre foi clara: mudar a lógica do mercado, elevar o padrão de qualidade e nos tornar top of mind no segmento. Em menos de dois anos de vida, já estamos entre as 5 maiores marcas do nosso mercado, resultado de visão estratégica, consistência e excelência na execução.


Esse crescimento é reflexo de inovação constante, cliente no centro das decisões, processos bem estruturados e produtos altamente desejados. Mas, acima de tudo, é sustentado por pessoas que entendem que vender bem também é cuidar — e que cada atendimento é uma oportunidade real de gerar impacto e resultado.


Sobre a posição | Assessor(a) de Atendimento Afetto (B2C)


Buscamos assessores(as) acima da média, com inteligência relacional, repertório emocional e fome de resultado.


Na Afetto, vendas são o centro do jogo. Nosso atendimento é consultivo, sofisticado e humano — mas o ciclo só se completa quando há decisão e fechamento. Aqui, não existe atendimento excelente sem conversão.


Você será o rosto da Afetto em cada contato, com papel decisivo na nossa expansão: transformar interesse em compra, dúvidas em segurança e comparação em escolha. Esperamos protagonismo, ritmo, organização e consistência. Se você gosta de metas, performance e crescimento, essa vaga é para você.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Conduzir atendimentos comerciais B2C com foco em conversão e fechamento ;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, ampliando ticket médio com soluções completas;
  • Dominar o portfólio Afetto para vender com segurança e autoridade;
  • Conduzir o cliente até a decisão com argumentação ética e follow-up estruturado;
  • Cumprir e superar metas de vendas e performance;
  • Manter organização do funil e qualidade em todas as etapas do atendimento.


Indicadores de Performance (KPIs)


  • Taxa de conversão de atendimentos em vendas;
  • Ticket médio por cliente;
  • Tempo e qualidade de follow-up ;
  • SLA de atendimento (tempo de resposta e retorno ao cliente);
  • Performance individual vs. metas comerciais mensais.


Requisitos


  • Comunicação verbal e escrita acima da média;
  • Forte argumentação comercial e influência ética;
  • Leitura refinada de pessoas e momentos de decisão;
  • Foco em metas, conversão e resultado ;
  • Organização, disciplina e senso de dono;
  • Segurança emocional para conduzir decisões e fechar ciclos.


Informações da vaga


  • Regime: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial
  • Local: São Paulo
  • Remuneração fixa + variável acima da média do mercado , atrelada à performance
  • Benefícios: VT + VR


Perfil Ideal

Na Afetto, vender bem é parte do cuidado. Buscamos pessoas que gostem de vendas , se responsabilizem por resultados e entendam que excelência só se completa quando o cliente decide comprar.


Candidate- se pelo LinkedIn Recruiter e venha crescer junto com uma marca que está redefinindo o mercado.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:

This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Job Title: SailPoint Developer


Job Location

Remote / Hybrid / Onsite (as applicable)


Experience

6–10+ years overall IAM experience

4–8+ years hands-on SailPoint development


Job Description Summary

We are seeking a SailPoint Developer with strong hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using SailPoint (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow). The role is focused on custom development, integrations, workflows, and automation , not platform administration or access provisioning support.

The ideal candidate will work closely with security, application, and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable IAM solutions aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement SailPoint IAM solutions (IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow)
  • Develop and customize workflows, rules, connectors, and lifecycle events
  • Build and maintain custom integrations between SailPoint and target systems (REST, SOAP, JDBC, LDAP, AD, Azure AD, etc.)
  • Develop custom provisioning logic , aggregation rules, and identity correlation logic
  • Implement access request, approval, and certification processes
  • Customize SailPoint UI components, forms, and reports as required
  • Develop and maintain policies, roles, entitlements, and governance models
  • Support user lifecycle management (Joiner–Mover–Leaver)
  • Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of SailPoint solutions
  • Participate in IAM solution design discussions and technical architecture reviews
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer
  • Collaborate with DevOps and security teams for deployments and upgrades
  • Support SailPoint upgrades and migrations (e.g., IIQ versions or IIQ → IdentityNow)


Required Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or IdentityNow
  • Proficiency in Java, BeanShell, JavaScript
  • Experience developing SailPoint rules (Aggregation, Provisioning, Correlation, Validation, Certification)
  • Strong experience with SailPoint workflows
  • Experience with REST/SOAP APIs , JSON, XML
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts : authentication, authorization, RBAC, access governance
  • Experience integrating with:
  • Active Directory / Azure AD
  • LDAP
  • Databases (JDBC)
  • Cloud and enterprise applications
  • Understanding of certifications, access reviews, SoD policies
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • SailPoint certifications (IdentityIQ Engineer, IdentityNow Engineer)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, CI/CD)
  • Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, SOX, GDPR)
  • Experience with PAM integrations (CyberArk, BeyondTrust)
  • Scripting knowledge (Python, PowerShell)


What This Role Is NOT

  • ❌ Not a SailPoint Administrator role
  • ❌ Not limited to user provisioning or access requests
  • ❌ Not a helpdesk or L2/L3 IAM support role


This is a core SailPoint development and engineering role .


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Good communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams
  • Security-first mindset

description:

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Assistente Administrativo (Compras & Financeiro)
description:
Estamos em busca de alguém centrado(a), organizado(a) e confiável para manter nosso dia a dia operacional fluindo com tranquilidade. O administrativo é essencial para conectar compras/supply, financeiro e cobranças, garantindo informações corretas, prazos cumpridos e processos bem cuidados, sempre com atenção aos detalhes.


O que esperamos de você:
  • Organização e cuidado com detalhes nas operações (ERP, processos e planilhas)
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e respeitosa com fornecedores e times internos
  • Disciplina de rotinas (cadastros, prazos, registros e conferências)
  • Postura colaborativa e foco em resolução tranquila de pendências
  • Olhar de melhoria contínua, propondo ajustes simples que facilitem o dia a dia do time

Você terá uma rotina estruturada, conectando compras, estoque, parceiros fabricantes e financeiro: conduzindo cotações e pedidos, acompanhando entregas, realizando lançamentos e conciliações, além de cobranças dentro das políticas da empresa.


Sobre a Natuterra

Lideramos a revolução alimentar com produtos naturais, saudáveis e veganos, com foco em bebidas vegetais inovadoras e de alta qualidade.


Suas principais missões
  • Compras / Supply: cotações, comparativos, negociação e emissão de pedidos; acompanhamento de entregas de materiais; pesquisa de parcerias, melhoria de condições de compra e otimização de suprimentos. 
  • Qualidade / Logística interna: acompanhamento de prazos e entregas de materiais, conferências e documentação de entradas.
  • Parceria com fabricantes: apoio ao planejamento e à execução de produções
  • Planejamento e estoque: apoio a planos anuais, inventários e rotinas de qualidade
  • Financeiro operacional: contas a pagar e a receber, lançamentos, conciliação e relatórios
  • Cobrança de inadimplentes: monitorar carteira, realizar cobrança de inadimplências e acompanhar processos de recuperação

    • Requisitos essenciais
    • 1–2 anos em compras/suprimentos e/ou administrativo/financeiro
    • Vivência com ERP Tiny e Excel/Google Sheets
    • Experiência com cobrança e relacionamento com fornecedores/clientes
    • Perfil calmo, organizado e responsável, com boa gestão de tempo e prioridades

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: DevSecops Engineer
description:
Project, Role and Task Descriptions:

• Design, implement, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines for application build, test, and deployment.

• Integrate security scanning, compliance checks, and vulnerability management into development and deployment workflows.

• Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and application deployment using modern DevSecOps tools.

• Collaborate with development, QA, security, and operations teams to ensure security is embedded throughout the SDLC.

• Support and enhance containerization, orchestration, and cloud environments with a strong focus on security best practices.


Candidate Must-Have Skills, Requirements and Nice-to -Have Skills:

o CI/CD, Version Control & Security Integration: Experience building enterprise-grade CI/CD pipelines. GitHub (branching, PR workflows, GitHub Actions), GitHub Actions (secure workflows, secrets management, runner configuration), Jenkins (scripted/declarative pipelines, shared libraries), SonarQube (code quality, SAST), Fortify (static code analysis, security scanning). Experience setting up artifact repositories (Nexus, JFrog, ECR)

o Configuration Management & Automation: Ansible (roles, playbooks, secure inventory handling). Puppet (manifests, modules, environment management). Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts and tooling (Terraform or CloudFrormation).

o Scripting & Development : Bash, Python, Groovy (both for Jenkins and development). Ability to write automation scripts.

o Cloud : EC2, S3, IAM (roles, policies, least privilege), VPC networking basics, AWS CloudWatch, SSM, ECS/EKS

• o Nice to have : Docker, Openshift, Helm

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

description:

  • Manage offers, checkout logic, bundles, upsells, and funnels

  • Manage segmentation and timed access rules
  • Ensure flawless execution of all automations & workflows

UI/UX Execution

  • Optimize mobile, tablet, and desktop experiences
  • Support designers + marketing with clean implementation


Operations & Support

  • Build orientation pages, resource hubs, dashboards
  • Manage student access, cohorts, and track progression
  • Maintain naming systems, file structures, and internal logic
  • Ensure instructors have correct access and materials

  • Deep Kajabi mastery (portfolio REQUIRED)

  • Figma → Kajabi implementation skills
  • HTML/CSS for custom Kajabi modifications
  • Advanced tagging, automation, and funnel-building skills

  • Obsessive attention to detail + QA mindset
  • Strong English communication
  • Fast, independent, and organized


Bonus:

  • EdTech or youth-education experience
  • Multi-cohort / multi-track course experience
  • Familiar with 54-week programs or long-form curriculum architecture


Who You Are

  • You are the person who ensures the system NEVER breaks.

  • If you love owning the tech stack, building smooth user journeys, and operating at a high standard — this role is for you.

title: Content Writer (Portuguese) - 53457
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Content Writer to create and refine content used in workflows, training data, and scenario-based evaluations for large language models (LLMs). You will help build realistic content samples, review AI-generated outputs, and ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create and edit content across formats such as articles, guides, workflows, and scenarios.
  • Recreate real-world content workflows for AI evaluation.
  • Review AI outputs for quality, accuracy, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Provide feedback and annotations to support LLM improvement.
  • Collaborate with product and AI teams to align content with operational needs.


Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years experience as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Technical Writer.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify content gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with documentation or workflow tools (e.g., Confluence, Notion, Zendesk, Jira).
  • Excellent written communication skills.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : at least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month


Evaluation Process :

  • Shortlisted candidates will be reviewed by our team internally and shortlisted candidates will be reached out for onboarding.

title: Data Scientist (Remoto) - Pleno/Sênior
description:
A AImana é a principal consultoria de automação com IA no Brasil, entregando soluções de ponta para clientes nos setores financeiro, varejo, logística e outros. Você fará parte de um time em rápido crescimento, que combina alta especialização técnica com uma cultura de abertura, experimentação e aprendizado contínuo.


Por que se juntar a nós?

Impacto Real : Assuma projetos estratégicos que automatizam e transformam processos centrais de negócio.

Mentalidade de Crescimento : Orçamento dedicado para cursos, conferências e certificações, mantendo você na linha de frente da inovação em IA.

Cultura Colaborativa : Trabalhe com uma equipe multidisciplinar que valoriza compartilhamento de conhecimento e mentoria.


Como Cientista de Dados Pleno/Sênior na AImana, você liderará o design, desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções avançadas de análise e machine learning de ponta a ponta. Você atuará diretamente com clientes para definir desafios de negócio, projetar modelos escaláveis e entregar estratégias orientadas a dados que geram valor mensurável.


Atividades:

• Gestão Completa: Conduzir projetos de ciência de dados desde o entendimento inicial e exploração de dados até modelagem, validação e implantação.

• Modelagem e Experimentação: Desenvolver e avaliar modelos preditivos, prescritivos e generativos utilizando Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch ou frameworks similares.

• Estratégia de Dados: Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de engenharia de dados para projetar pipelines robustos, garantindo qualidade, reprodutibilidade e escalabilidade.

• IA Aplicada: Utilizar técnicas avançadas como LLMs, deep learning, previsão de séries temporais, NLP e otimização para impacto direto em problemas reais.

• Rigor Estatístico: Aplicar desenho experimental sólido, testes A/B e inferência causal para orientar decisões de produto e negócio.

• MLOps e Implantação: Colaborar com engenheiros de ML para colocar modelos em produção usando práticas modernas de CI/CD, conteinerização e plataformas em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

• Interação com Clientes: Comunicar insights e resultados técnicos para públicos não técnicos, traduzindo soluções de ciência de dados em recomendações estratégicas.

• Mentoria: Orientar cientistas de dados juniores, promover boas práticas e contribuir para os playbooks internos da AImana.



Requisitos:

• Experiência profissional em ciência de dados, machine learning ou estatística aplicada.

• Experiência comprovada construindo e implantando modelos de ML e pipelines de dados em produção.

• Forte domínio de Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

• Sólido conhecimento em SQL, modelagem de dados e engenharia de features.

• Experiência com MLOps, versionamento (Git) e plataformas em nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure).

• Expertise em uma ou mais áreas avançadas: NLP, fine-tuning de LLMs, sistemas de recomendação, previsão ou otimização.

• Excelente base em estatística, probabilidade e desenho experimental.

• Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir análises complexas para executivos.

• Fluência em português e inglês; confortável em conduzir conversas com clientes e equipes multidisciplinares.



O que você vai encontrar :


• Oportunidade de construir o futuro com IA, atuando com tecnologias de ponta.

• Ambiente altamente inovador, com abertura para experimentação

• Cultura que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo, colaboração e crescimento.



Vaga 100% remota

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:

title: Data Scientist (Remoto) - Pleno/Sênior
description:
A AImana é a principal consultoria de automação com IA no Brasil, entregando soluções de ponta para clientes nos setores financeiro, varejo, logística e outros. Você fará parte de um time em rápido crescimento, que combina alta especialização técnica com uma cultura de abertura, experimentação e aprendizado contínuo.


Por que se juntar a nós?

Impacto Real : Assuma projetos estratégicos que automatizam e transformam processos centrais de negócio.

Mentalidade de Crescimento : Orçamento dedicado para cursos, conferências e certificações, mantendo você na linha de frente da inovação em IA.

Cultura Colaborativa : Trabalhe com uma equipe multidisciplinar que valoriza compartilhamento de conhecimento e mentoria.


Como Cientista de Dados Pleno/Sênior na AImana, você liderará o design, desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções avançadas de análise e machine learning de ponta a ponta. Você atuará diretamente com clientes para definir desafios de negócio, projetar modelos escaláveis e entregar estratégias orientadas a dados que geram valor mensurável.


Atividades:

• Gestão Completa: Conduzir projetos de ciência de dados desde o entendimento inicial e exploração de dados até modelagem, validação e implantação.

• Modelagem e Experimentação: Desenvolver e avaliar modelos preditivos, prescritivos e generativos utilizando Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch ou frameworks similares.

• Estratégia de Dados: Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de engenharia de dados para projetar pipelines robustos, garantindo qualidade, reprodutibilidade e escalabilidade.

• IA Aplicada: Utilizar técnicas avançadas como LLMs, deep learning, previsão de séries temporais, NLP e otimização para impacto direto em problemas reais.

• Rigor Estatístico: Aplicar desenho experimental sólido, testes A/B e inferência causal para orientar decisões de produto e negócio.

• MLOps e Implantação: Colaborar com engenheiros de ML para colocar modelos em produção usando práticas modernas de CI/CD, conteinerização e plataformas em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

• Interação com Clientes: Comunicar insights e resultados técnicos para públicos não técnicos, traduzindo soluções de ciência de dados em recomendações estratégicas.

• Mentoria: Orientar cientistas de dados juniores, promover boas práticas e contribuir para os playbooks internos da AImana.



Requisitos:

• Experiência profissional em ciência de dados, machine learning ou estatística aplicada.

• Experiência comprovada construindo e implantando modelos de ML e pipelines de dados em produção.

• Forte domínio de Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

• Sólido conhecimento em SQL, modelagem de dados e engenharia de features.

• Experiência com MLOps, versionamento (Git) e plataformas em nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure).

• Expertise em uma ou mais áreas avançadas: NLP, fine-tuning de LLMs, sistemas de recomendação, previsão ou otimização.

• Excelente base em estatística, probabilidade e desenho experimental.

• Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir análises complexas para executivos.

• Fluência em português e inglês; confortável em conduzir conversas com clientes e equipes multidisciplinares.



O que você vai encontrar :


• Oportunidade de construir o futuro com IA, atuando com tecnologias de ponta.

• Ambiente altamente inovador, com abertura para experimentação

• Cultura que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo, colaboração e crescimento.



Vaga 100% remota

Cultura Colaborativa : Trabalhe com uma equipe multidisciplinar que valoriza compartilhamento de conhecimento e mentoria.


Como Cientista de Dados Pleno/Sênior na AImana, você liderará o design, desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções avançadas de análise e machine learning de ponta a ponta. Você atuará diretamente com clientes para definir desafios de negócio, projetar modelos escaláveis e entregar estratégias orientadas a dados que geram valor mensurável.


Atividades:

• Gestão Completa: Conduzir projetos de ciência de dados desde o entendimento inicial e exploração de dados até modelagem, validação e implantação.

• Modelagem e Experimentação: Desenvolver e avaliar modelos preditivos, prescritivos e generativos utilizando Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch ou frameworks similares.

• Estratégia de Dados: Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de engenharia de dados para projetar pipelines robustos, garantindo qualidade, reprodutibilidade e escalabilidade.

• IA Aplicada: Utilizar técnicas avançadas como LLMs, deep learning, previsão de séries temporais, NLP e otimização para impacto direto em problemas reais.

• Rigor Estatístico: Aplicar desenho experimental sólido, testes A/B e inferência causal para orientar decisões de produto e negócio.

• MLOps e Implantação: Colaborar com engenheiros de ML para colocar modelos em produção usando práticas modernas de CI/CD, conteinerização e plataformas em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

• Interação com Clientes: Comunicar insights e resultados técnicos para públicos não técnicos, traduzindo soluções de ciência de dados em recomendações estratégicas.

• Mentoria: Orientar cientistas de dados juniores, promover boas práticas e contribuir para os playbooks internos da AImana.



Requisitos:

• Experiência profissional em ciência de dados, machine learning ou estatística aplicada.

• Experiência comprovada construindo e implantando modelos de ML e pipelines de dados em produção.

• Forte domínio de Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch).

• Sólido conhecimento em SQL, modelagem de dados e engenharia de features.

• Experiência com MLOps, versionamento (Git) e plataformas em nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure).

• Expertise em uma ou mais áreas avançadas: NLP, fine-tuning de LLMs, sistemas de recomendação, previsão ou otimização.

• Excelente base em estatística, probabilidade e desenho experimental.

• Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir análises complexas para executivos.

• Fluência em português e inglês; confortável em conduzir conversas com clientes e equipes multidisciplinares.



O que você vai encontrar :


• Oportunidade de construir o futuro com IA, atuando com tecnologias de ponta.

• Ambiente altamente inovador, com abertura para experimentação

• Cultura que valoriza autonomia, aprendizado contínuo, colaboração e crescimento.



Vaga 100% remota

description:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

description:

Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events.   • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;

  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Superior completo em Arquitetura, hotelaria ou turismo;
Domínio dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
Pacote Office avançado;
Power BI será um diferencial;
Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;
Conhecimento de regulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.
Local de Trabalho: Boulevard Shopping Feira de Santana
Escala: Trabalha 5 dias e folga 2

Nascemos para simplificar a energia, algo essencial, mas que hoje parece distante e complexo. O brasileiro paga uma das contas de luz mais caras do mundo, muitas vezes sem saber que tem uma escolha. Quando descobre, a complexidade e a falta de transparência do setor geram desconfiança.

Experiência prévia com conteúdo nativo para redes sociais (da estratégia à execução).

Organização para operar calendário, múltiplas entregas e interface com freelas/fornecedores.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

  • Power BI será um diferencial;

  • Conhecimento deregulamentações e normas de segurança e qualidade.
